patterns.note: Content is consistently presented within full-width sections, with primary content centered in a fixed-width container, creating clear visual boundaries.
A three-column grid is frequently used for presenting related items such as statistics, solution features, and news articles, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm.
Section introductory labels are consistently set in a smaller, uppercase, light-weight sans-serif, providing a clear hierarchy before the main heading.
A deep, dark blue is used as a primary brand color for the sticky navigation and footer, providing a strong, authoritative base for the site's identity.
The top navigation bar transforms upon scroll, changing from a transparent background with dark branding to a solid dark blue background with white branding.
The hero section features a subtle background parallax effect, where the textured background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content.
The 'Latest news & resources' section uses a card-based layout with images, titles, and metadata, allowing for easy scanning of multiple content pieces.

technique_notes: The site employs a transforming sticky header that changes its background color and logo/text color scheme from transparent/dark to solid/light as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
A subtle parallax effect is used in the hero section, where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each with a clear heading and often using a grid system for presenting information, such as feature cards or news articles.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very large, heavy numbers for statistics.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards, maintaining a professional yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing in the hero section and well-defined padding around content blocks, creating an airy but structured density.

standout: The transforming sticky navigation bar, which elegantly switches from a transparent, dark-text state to a solid, light-text state upon scroll, adds a layer of sophistication. This, combined with the subtle hero background parallax, elevates the site beyond a standard corporate template, conveying a sense of polished professionalism.
